ko.title: Rethinking the Internal Signal Path — Deep-research verification revision
ko.excerpt: ESH/Eshtronic의 현재 공식 사양과 역사적 routing evidence를 분리하고, EMG 35/40-series active pickup, passive piezo input boundary, B125 per-input buffering, low-Z control placement와 switching transient를 제조사·기술 자료로 재검증한다. 핵심 주장을 Confirmed / Partially confirmed / Unverified / Contradicted로 분류하고, 10 MΩ piezo와 25 kΩ active-control 같은 과잉 일반화를 수정하며 RavenForge routing taxonomy를 engineering synthesis로 명확히 구분한다.

en.title: Rethinking the Internal Signal Path — Deep-research verification revision
en.excerpt: Re-audit B06 against manufacturer and technical sources. Separate current ESH/Eshtronic specifications from historical routing evidence; verify EMG 35/40-series active pickup data, passive-piezo input boundaries, B125 per-input buffering, low-Z control placement and switching transients. Classify key claims by evidence status and correct overgeneralizations such as universal 10 MΩ piezo or 25 kΩ active-control rules.

de.title: Rethinking the Internal Signal Path — Deep-Research-Verifikationsrevision
de.excerpt: B06 wird anhand von Hersteller- und Technikquellen neu geprüft. Aktuelle ESH/Eshtronic-Spezifikationen werden von historischem Routing getrennt; EMG-35/40-Daten, passive Piezo-Grenzen, B125-Puffer, Low-Z-Reglerplatzierung und Switching-Transienten werden verifiziert. Kernaussagen erhalten Evidenzstatus, universalisierte 10-MΩ-/25-kΩ-Regeln werden korrigiert und die RavenForge-Taxonomie als Engineering-Synthese gekennzeichnet.
